E8Leech/E8Coordinates.lean contains a coordinate table and finite-certificate pattern
adapted from TauCetiProject/TauCeti under the Apache License 2.0 (included in licenses/TauCeti-Apache-2.0.txt).
Copyright (c) 2026 The Tau Ceti contributors.
Upstream commit: 98962476aaba1de05b4a883df5af0562247cb501
Upstream path: TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/E8Coordinates.lean
Changes: local namespace, explicit Gram matrix, doubled-coordinate E8 set,
membership lemmas, and compatibility with Lean 4.33.1 without the DynkinType dependency.

Files under research/sources are public upstream source snapshots for research.
They are not imported by the local Lean library. Original license notices are preserved;
these snapshots are not a claim that the upstream projects have been built or axiom-audited.

E8Leech/CountingKernel.lean adapts the simple-function approximation argument from
Mathlib/Probability/Kernel/MeasurableLIntegral.lean, copyright (c) 2023 Rémy Degenne.
Upstream mathlib commit: 0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474.
Changes: pointwise finite fibers instead of the global IsFiniteKernel hypothesis;
compact counting-kernel exhaustion and parameter-dependent count queries.
Apache License 2.0 is included in licenses/Mathlib-Apache-2.0.txt.
Sparse pinned Mathlib output files were built locally from read-only sources;
no upstream source changes are made by the support-build script.

LeanLevy selected-source snapshots are at fixed commit
7e73fd9b23ad52956ec2756a815889a783131ce4; its MIT LICENSE is preserved in
research/sources/slink/LeanLevy/LICENSE. These are research references only,
not imported or claimed to be transitively axiom-audited.

E8Leech/E8Lattice.lean adapts the lower triangular E8 basis and determinant/basis
proof pattern from Sphere-Packing-Lean, copyright (c) 2025 Bhavik Mehta, Gareth Ma.
Upstream commit: cbe754e5b699945fd391e6398e6293e9fafa16ec.
Upstream path: SpherePacking/Basic/E8.lean.
Changes: doubled integer numerator table; explicit inverse integer coefficients;
identification with the local congruence set; local Euclidean basis and covolume proof.
Apache License 2.0 is included in licenses/Sphere-Packing-Apache-2.0.txt.
The upstream main theorem and unfinished LP proofs are not imported.

E8Leech/Golay.lean adapts the explicit Golay generator block, message equivalence,
weight table, and sixteen split kernel certificates from TauCetiProject/TauCeti.
Copyright (c) 2026 The Tau Ceti contributors.
Upstream commit: 98962476aaba1de05b4a883df5af0562247cb501.
Upstream path: TauCeti/InformationTheory/Coding/Binary/Golay/Basic.lean.
Changes: local linear-map range in place of upstream LinearCode; local encoding;
Lean 4.33.1 compatibility; no Construction A, weight-enumerator or TypeII imports.
Apache License 2.0 is included in licenses/TauCeti-Apache-2.0.txt.
LeechCoordinates and LeechGeometry use the parity/Golay/mod-eight construction
described by Conway, Goodman-Strauss and Sloane, Recent Progress in Sphere Packing,
p. 32, https://strauss.hosted.uark.edu/papers/sphere.pdf, with sqrt(8) normalization.

E8Leech/LeechBasis.lean reuses the determinant-to-basis and volume-transfer
proof pattern from the above Sphere-Packing-Lean attribution, through E8Lattice.lean.
The Leech reconstruction, upper-triangular determinant and odd-row replacement
proofs are local; the external candidate generator is not a proof input.

Historical, retired override:
research/mathlib-patches/Mathlib/Analysis/Fourier/FourierTransform.lean is an
explicit local copy and former proof-only override of the pinned Mathlib module.
Copyright (c) 2023 David Loeffler; Apache License 2.0, retained in the file and
licenses/Mathlib-Apache-2.0.txt. Upstream revision:
0df444a360eaa60ab8c11dca51a86af692955474.
Changes: only the norm-domination subproof of
VectorFourier.integral_fourierIntegral_swap. Explicit real norm nonnegativity
and Circle.norm_smul replace convert!/simp; definitions and statement types
are unchanged. Original source is read-only. The diff, both source hashes,
reproduction commands, successful compile and separate axiom/olean hash audit
are recorded in research/mathlib-patches and research/fourier-support-audit-20261009.json.
This is not an unmodified clean dependency source build. SpectralFiniteForms
and SpectralPairForms contain local proofs using this pinned Fourier API;
TauCeti's reviewed positive-definite API is a research reference, not an import.

Current dependency status (2026-10-09): the preceding historical override is
retired and not used in the current Lean library. The unmodified pinned original
FourierTransform source compiles with upstream autoImplicit=false and
maxSynthPendingDepth=3 settings. Source/olean and axiom audit records are in
research/mathlib-support-fourier-upstream-20261009.json and
research/fourier-upstream-support-audit-20261009.json. Unchanged read-only upstream
sources also supply Schwartz support and Int.Star, with separate hash records.
This remains pinned-cache incremental verification, not a clean Lake/CI build.

E8Leech/ModularCoefficientBounds.lean and
E8Leech/ExponentialPolynomialCertificates.lean independently prove the mathematical
inequalities (60), (61), and (41), with coefficients from Seewoo Lee,
Inequalities involving polynomials and quasimodular forms, arXiv:2602.10536v1,
https://arxiv.org/html/2602.10536v1, Lemma 3.5 and Appendix A.
The original posqmf proofs were read and individually built as temporary
references at commit 6641dda593fa75db6c7b5e5023a890bdcb6266a9. They are not copied
wholesale into this public library. No repository licence was confirmed.
See research/posqmf-source-audit-20261009.json. The local Taylor-series proof,
coarse exponential bound and integer checker are independent implementations.
No Ramanujan-identity axiom or unfinished analytic-family identification is
imported from the reference repository.

scripts/ReplayProjectOnce.lean adapts the module-data loading routine from
Lean 4.33.1 src/LeanChecker.lean, copyright (c) 2023 Kim Morrison.
Original authors: Kim Morrison and Sebastian Ullrich; Apache License 2.0.
The same license terms are included in licenses/Mathlib-Apache-2.0.txt.
Changes: collect all selected project declarations, load their external imports
once, reject preloaded project declarations, then call Lean.Environment.replay.
It uses Lean's own kernel, not an independent checker. The exact installed
upstream source hash and scope are in research/leanchecker-scope-review-20261010.json.

E8Leech/ThetaFunctions.lean and E8Leech/ThetaIdentities.lean follow the mathematical route
of SpherePacking/ModularForms/JacobiTheta.lean in math-inc/Sphere-Packing-Lean
(commit 1e98fb493088948ca7bbf47d7faed49cc5b39fc4, source SHA256
859675e58ea09af4d4d06bf45e359cddbc9888ef4d58107b52bebd03847f6a48) and of its LeanPool port
LeanPool/LeanModularForms/Modularforms/JacobiTheta.lean (copyright (c) 2026 Chris Birkbeck,
commit c4d20f0eae6bf3d2577dbea91749d2a080dbbf3c, source SHA256
ee4eb6e4dc6012cdd77b150e5dddc5a50bb19642aa6e8ee1368792496c92d03a), both Apache License 2.0
(licenses/Sphere-Packing-Apache-2.0.txt). No upstream file is imported or copied verbatim.
Changes: pointwise statements on the pinned Mathlib, branch-free fourth-power inversion laws,
a generic level-one cusp-form constructor from the S and T laws, Tannery majorants
‖jacobiTheta₂_term n z I‖, and new lambda/imaginary-axis corollaries.

SpherePacking/ contains ported files of Sphere-Packing-Lean (Math, Inc. version),
copyright held by the authors named in each file header.
Upstream: https://github.com/math-inc/Sphere-Packing-Lean
Upstream commit: 1e98fb493088948ca7bbf47d7faed49cc5b39fc4 (Lean v4.28.0 / Mathlib v4.28.0).
Apache License 2.0 is included in licenses/Sphere-Packing-Apache-2.0.txt.
Changes: port to Lean 4.33.1 and this project's pinned Mathlib; each modified file carries a
modification line; the kinds of changes and the per-file list are in SpherePacking/PORTING.txt.
No ported statement is weakened. E8Leech/SPLPackingDensity.lean uses the ported periodic-packing
density formula; it does not use any packing optimality theorem.
